Package cafe94.system.controller.customer

Class OrderDetailsPopupController

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.controller.customer.OrderDetailsPopupController
public class OrderDetailsPopupController extends Object
Controller for the Order Details pop-up used during order confirmation in the Cafe94 system.

This controller handles:

  • Displaying order items and totals
  • Capturing additional information for takeaway and delivery orders
  • Validating user inputs such as pickup time and delivery address
  • Returning confirmation status and user-entered values to the caller
It supports both TakeawayOrder and DeliveryOrder types, dynamically showing relevant input fields.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      public void setup(Order order, Customer customer)
      Initializes the pop-up with order details and the associated customer. Displays appropriate fields based on the order type (Takeaway or Delivery).
      Parameters:
      order - The order being reviewed and confirmed.
      customer - The customer placing the order.

    • setupTimeSelectors

      private void setupTimeSelectors()
      Initializes the time selection ComboBoxes to be non-editable. This ensures users can only select from predefined times.

    • populateOrderTable

      private void populateOrderTable(Order order)
      Populates the order summary table with the items from the given order. Also calculates and updates the total price label.
      Parameters:
      order - The order whose items should be displayed.

    • handleUseProfileAddress

      private void handleUseProfileAddress()
      Toggles whether to auto-fill the delivery address with the customer's profile address. This is triggered when the "Use Profile Address" checkbox is selected or deselected.

    • handleConfirm

      private void handleConfirm()
      Validates the user's input and confirms the order details if valid. This includes time selection and address validation depending on order type. If validation passes, the confirmation window is closed.
